Will be released on 27 Apr 2022 Seven Wonders: Chapter 2.75 Update

collect/craft the following

#3 Defeat Pizzaro for a chance to get Golden Arc

#4 After defeating Koxinga craft Prince of Yanping's Strategy Book
#5 After defeating Ithaqua's Wise King craft Wooden Horse Blueprint
#6 After defeating Pizzaro craft Requerimiento

Gets Legendary Shoes for completing the MA
